objective: Make the RA2 strategic bot's attack decisions enemy-aware (the measured cause of the blind 131 s rush), then run a pre-registered local-LLM shadow pass, then correct PR #2 and rerun the tournament so the branch is mergeable.
constraints: Work in /projects/dev/_wt/bindery-ra2-bot on branch feat/strategic-bot (PR #2 open, NOT merged; operator merges). Never touch the main checkout /projects/dev/bindery-ra2-adapter.

dotnet only via: nix shell nixpkgs#dotnet-sdk_8 -c dotnet <args>, with the Bash dangerouslyDisableSandbox parameter (network restore; pre-approved). Parallel dotnet runs are fine. TreatWarningsAsErrors.
Every fix: a test you ran and saw FAIL before and PASS after. Never weaken invariant tests (fog, late-discard, ownership, validator, the new mirror/numbering invariants in SimMapsTests).
Any report or PR text must quote the raw dotnet test totals; two Codex successors overstated results (Terra reported a failing test as passing).
tools/Bindery.Ra2.Bot.Baseline stays frozen; its only permitted edit (placement tie-break) is done.

Bulk LLM work uses the local endpoint (--llm-endpoint http://127.0.0.1:8020/v1 --llm-model worker-fast). Do NOT use opencode-go for the bot (terms: coding-agent traffic only). opencode-zen (paid) only for explicit live-Claude runs.
Held-out maps/opponents are for evaluation only; never tune on them. Pre-register thresholds before any LLM evaluation run.
No sprintctl writes without operator permission (auto-mode denied them); Codex launches need the operator's launch permission.

decisions.what: Map fairness fixed at 24b0738: canonical mirror numbering in SimMaps.Build, RegionGraph.Path lowest-id equal predecessor, MapInfo.RegionOf mirror-invariant tie-break, centre-relative sim positions; invariants in SimMapsTests; MirrorMatchTests covers 4 maps.
decisions.why: Per-seed side-independence: river-crossing/open-steppe/fortress-choke 24/24, island-bridges 4W/4E, twin-valley 6W/2E (cross-side ties unfixable by ids). Mirror shares 26/45, 24/48, 24/48, 24/48.

decisions.what: Frozen baseline placement tie-break fixed at 02d0645 (operator-approved one-off).
decisions.why: Arena always starts the opponent east; the old lowest-X rule put east bases' buildings forward, handicapping every pinned style.

decisions.what: OpenAI-compatible strategist client + arena --llm-endpoint/--llm-model at 2e49971; local worker-fast works (16 shadow proposals/match, 0 failed/rejected, ~6.5 s/call, agreed with selector 4/16).
decisions.why: Free bulk LLM validation without an Anthropic credential; arms are labelled llm-openai:<model>.

decisions.what: Operator approved the change order: (1) enemy-aware attack gating, (2) arena fairness, (3) Verses-based effectiveness + build-time multipliers in rules import, (4) persistent squad roles. Then bandit fix and Full-vocabulary shadow.

Operator's target architecture: LLM writes playbooks in a typed plan language; fast typed tactical tier (classifier or Jev-style System One model); deterministic executors; three levels core/genre/game-adapter; custom-AI plug-in interface.
decisions.why: Recorded in the critique file; an ADR draft is a pending follow-up.

rejected.what: ArmyValueRatio = NaN (unknown) when the enemy is unseen, as the fix for the blind rush
rejected.why: Measured no effect: OOS cell 40/72 selector, 52/72 oracle, first attack 131 s before and after. The selector's playbooks (soviet-flak-mix, allied-ifv-mix) attack on OwnArmyValue >= 1200 only. Reverted; do not retry.

rejected.what: Mirror test with opponent live-balanced (bot vs itself)
rejected.why: Degenerate: the opponent slot wins 100% on every map, side and faction, so side share is always 50%. Arm/opponent configs differ; uninvestigated.

rejected.what: opencode-go as the bulk LLM backend
rejected.why: Its terms require coding-agent traffic with session ids and cap 5h/weekly usage; faking a session header would misrepresent the traffic.

rejected.what: Trusting successor reports (Luna, Terra) without rerunning tests
rejected.why: Both overstated; Terra's own MirrorMatchTests was failing when it reported it passing.

rejected.what: Region-id numbering as the only fairness fix
rejected.why: Cross-side ties (one region on each side) cannot be mirrored by any id order; they remain on twin-valley (6W/2E) and are within the test guard.

Why the opponent slot always wins bot-vs-itself (balanced vs live-balanced).
